narrative: Sysdig pulled its cloud-native protection platform out of its own dashboard and shipped vulnerability prioritization, misconfiguration remediation, runtime threat investigation, and onboarding as tool-call surfaces inside Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and a generic MCP-server interface, with weekly skill cadence — a mainstream security vendor explicitly favoring the headless agentic-IDE surface over its own UI.
remaining_gap: Second and third major dashboard vendors must ship analogous headless skill surfaces with MCP-server metadata before the standardization thesis hardens.
